MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HD Fire TV Stick gives my TV a useful streaming option alongside my DVD player, so it fills a clear gap in equipment I already use.",
    "HD seems sufficient for my recorded 720p TV; I value a feature that fits my setup more than an upgrade I cannot clearly use."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Alexa plugs, speakers, displays, and car device add voice-control functions I have not been seeking; my power and car accessories serve specific charging and navigation needs.",
    "The 16TB drive and 4TB internal SSD relate loosely to my memory-card purchases, but neither matches an established capacity need or a planned computer upgrade.",
    "The earbuds do not connect to a current need, and the smart displays offer no clear additional use alongside my tablet."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning a Fire tablet seems to have been treated as interest in a whole range of Amazon and Alexa devices, although I choose accessories for particular uses.",
    "Buying memory cards seems to have been interpreted as wanting much larger storage of any kind, overlooking the devices and capacities involved."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of tripods, memory cards, a card reader, and a lens cap suggest ongoing camera and removable-storage needs that receive little attention here.",
    "My cables, mounts, cases, and power strips show that compatibility and a concrete job matter to me; a related device needs to solve an actual problem.",
    "My existing TV and tablet help explain why HD streaming is useful while 4K features and another screen have less immediate value."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my electronics use but mostly missed my preference for compatible accessories that fill specific needs in my existing setup."
}
